summary: Frontend-only regression + new features for CrossFade3D rewrite, Calculator polish, IntegrationsStrip rebuild, Team page/route, and Navbar entry. Verified across desktop (1440) and mobile (390). All critical acceptance criteria met: no console pageerrors, 0 horizontal overflow at both viewports, no 2D->3D flash observed on #workflow/#product/#platform (WebGL browser renders 3D via shared drei <View> canvas; one <canvas> total), calculator testids complete and toggle/you-marker behave, Integrations has mint pill + heading + sync rail + 3 live channel cards + combined pipeline card (LinkedIn 68 / TikTok 41) + dark-green request card, Team page renders white panel on dark with chip '001 • TEAM', heading 'Meet the Fluxvex Minds', 5 visible cards (center colored with 3 social icons, sides grayscale), names+roles, prev/next updates progress gradient line, and auto-advance (~4.2s) rotates center without hover. Navbar pages-item-our-team present in All Pages dropdown and routes to /team.
action_items: Non-blocking: console shows repeated 'WARNING: Too many active WebGL contexts. Oldest context will be lost.' Both CrossFade3D.glSupported() and Scene3D (useEffect) each create a throwaway <canvas>+WebGL context per section (~20+). These contexts are not explicitly lost via loseContext() and accumulate until Chrome evicts them. Recommend consolidating to a single module-level glSupported cache (one shared check used by both components) and/or calling getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context').loseContext() on the probe canvas to free it. Does not break rendering (the shared drei <View> canvas works fine) but is noisy and could cause the first eviction to drop the active scene canvas in theory.
critical_code_review_comments: CrossFade3D.jsx + Scene3D.jsx: duplicate glSupported probe logic. CrossFade already gates on supported, yet Scene3D runs its own probe in useEffect and renders only when glOk — redundant. Could remove the Scene3D probe since parent guarantees WebGL, saving ~N wasted canvas contexts.
Team.jsx TEAM array length = 6 (not 5). Request stated 5 members but code has 6; progress calc uses TEAM.length so math is correct ((active+1)/6). Confirm with product whether 5 or 6 intended.
No files >700 lines spotted; env usage looks correct; data-testid coverage on new Team controls is good.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Team page auto-advance is confirmed working (~4.2s). Center active card detection: iterate [data-testid^='team-card-'] and find the one whose className does NOT include 'grayscale' and bounding width > 100 (sides are smaller/grayscale). Progress inner width lives on the motion.div child of [data-testid='team-progress'] (framer-motion sets width inline on child, not container; use firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width). WebGL context-warning spam is a known noise item worth addressing. The 'INITIAL INTEGRATION FOCUS' pill contains hidden decorative characters/whitespace — don't use strict equality in evaluate; use includes().
